categories.problems: Unreadable SDF, missing files/mapping, invalid coordinate frame
categories.detection: Input validation; missing evidence stops, unreadable molecule retained
categories.scope: Repair input/export upstream; molecular edits cannot reconstruct absent evidence

categories.problems: Valence, bond order, aromaticity, fixed elements/charges
categories.detection: RDKit chemistry problems with atom IDs; mapped fixed graph comparison
categories.scope: Bounded template restoration or local invalid-bond hypotheses; no arbitrary generated-core reconstruction

categories.problems: Disconnected components, missing or incompatible attachments
categories.detection: Connected components; fixed-boundary signatures; spatial candidate pairs
categories.scope: Nearby admissible single bonds only; no long missing-linker invention

categories.problems: Bond length/angle, internal clash, aromatic/double-bond planarity, strain
categories.detection: All configured PoseBusters intramolecular checks, local geometry details
categories.scope: Bounded force field relaxation or anchored conformer reconstruction

categories.problems: Protein, water, organic/inorganic cofactor clashes and volume overlap; wrong pocket placement
categories.detection: All configured PoseBusters environment checks; residue-resolved distance pairs
categories.scope: No protein movement or deletion of real cofactors; frame mismatch requires corrected inputs

categories.problems: Fixed-fragment drift, fixed stereochemistry, attachment signature, unchanged scaffold
categories.detection: Mapping, displacement, local fully mapped tetrahedral geometry, boundary signatures, Murcko identity
categories.scope: Only applicable structural interventions. Extra task flags remain separate; novel scaffold design is not a coordinate repair

categories.problems: Low drug-likeness, difficult synthesis, structural alerts
categories.detection: QED, SA when available, logP, molecular weight, PAINS alerts
categories.scope: Descriptive scores/alerts, not universal binary failures; no automatic efficacy/toxicity/synthesis claim

categories.problems: Duplicates, low diversity, lack of novelty
categories.detection: Batch uniqueness/diversity. Training-set novelty unassessed without comparison data
categories.scope: Resampling/retraining needs generator access; deleting duplicates is not repairing molecules

categories.problems: Poor binding/interaction retention, docking-workflow inconsistency, activity/selectivity
categories.detection: Explicitly unassessed: no docking/interaction/experimental oracle configured
categories.scope: Requires target-specific oracle and fixed protocol; structural pass does not establish activity
